response.original_title: Lei Su Deng Shandian Chong Xian
response.overview: The twin brothers Frank and Karl excelled in every subject at school. They were good at sports and excellent students, but… a small remote-controlled race car caught them off guard. It was just a small remote-controlled race car, but mastering it is another story! Frank and Karl joined a race car club to hone their skills in this area. They learned various maneuvers and made some friends. But what they discovered was that remote-controlled car racing isn’t as simple as they’d imagined.
